name: Genetic Syndrome with Limb Malformations as a Major Feature

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Genetic Limb Malformation Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of congenital limb malformations including syndactyly, polydactyly, or limb hypoplasia
Identification of pathogenic variant in gene(s) associated with limb development
Presence of additional congenital anomalies such as craniofacial dysmorphism or cardiac defects

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of major limb malformations plus either genetic confirmation or at least one associated anomaly
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is strongly recommended to confirm diagnosis and guide management.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Congenital syndactyly of fingers or toes
searchTerms: fused fingers or toes from birth
congenital syndactyly of hands or feet

pathognomonic.symptomName: Polydactyly (extra digits) of hands or feet
searchTerms: additional digits on hands or feet
small or absent arms or legs

common.symptomName: Craniofacial dysmorphism including hypertelorism and micrognathia
searchTerms: unusual facial features like wide eyes and small jaw
craniofacial abnormalities including hypertelorism and micrognathia
distinctive face shape with spaced eyes and small chin

common.symptomName: Congenital cardiac anomalies such as septal defects
searchTerms: congenital heart problems like septal holes

common.symptomName: Developmental delay or mild intellectual disability
searchTerms: delayed development or mild learning difficulties

occasional.symptomName: Hearing impairment due to middle ear malformations
searchTerms: hearing loss from middle ear problems
impaired hearing due to ear malformations
middle ear structural defects causing hearing issues

occasional.symptomName: Renal anomalies including hypoplasia or cystic changes
searchTerms: kidney abnormalities like small size or cysts
skin webbing between fingers or toes

rare.symptomName: Respiratory complications due to thoracic malformations
searchTerms: respiratory issues due to thoracic defects
lung complications from chest wall abnormalities

laboratory: Genetic testing revealing pathogenic variants in limb development genes (e.g., HOXD13, GLI3)
Normal routine blood tests unless secondary complications present
imaging: X-rays showing bone malformations and digit anomalies
genetic: Autosomal dominant or recessive inheritance patterns depending on gene involved
Mutations in genes regulating limb morphogenesis
other: Physical examination revealing characteristic limb malformations
Developmental assessment for cognitive and motor delays

distinguishingFeatures: Polydactyly with syndactyly but distinct genetic mutation (GLI3)

redFlags: Severe limb hypoplasia causing functional impairment
Congenital heart defects with hemodynamic compromise
references: Orphanet: Genetic syndrome with limb malformations as a major feature - ORPHA:404577
